items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 16 at 12:43AM CST until November 16 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 25 knots with gusts up to 30 knots
and rough waters.

* WHERE...Baffin Bay and Upper Laguna Madre, Corpus Christi and
Nueces Bays, Copano, Aransas, and Redfish Bays and San
Antonio, Mesquite, and Espiritu Santo Bays.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM CST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 16 at 12:43AM CST until November 16 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, northeast winds 25 to 30 knots with
frequent gusts up to 35 knots and seas 8 to 13 feet. For the
Small Craft Advisory, northeast winds 15 to 25 knots with gusts
up to 30 knots and seas 6 to 11 feet expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Baffin Bay to Port Aransas out 20
NM, Coastal waters from Port Aransas to Matagorda Ship Channel
out 20 NM, Waters from Baffin Bay to Port Aransas from 20 to
60 NM and Waters from Port Aransas to Matagorda Ship Channel
from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...For the Gale Warning, until 6 PM CST this evening. For
the Small Craft Advisory, from 6 PM this evening to 6 AM CST
Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gale force winds and high seas will result in
dangerous marine conditions which could result in capsized or
damaged vessels.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Small Craft Advisory conditions may
continue through the day Tuesday.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
